design_history: Design v1 (a nice-value ladder) failed calibration and its holdout never ran (docs/validation/frame-campaign-v1). Design v2 was chosen after seeing that calibration data; the v2 calibration and holdout are fresh runs.
scope: Frame p99 of a CPU-bound, CPU-pinned vkcube logged by MangoHud, under busy-loop interference of 0, 1 and 3 loops. Supports only large frame-p99 effects (3x or more); it does not establish that a smaller effect is real or absent.
note: Frozen from calibration pairs before any holdout run existed, then evaluated once on the untouched holdout. The controller ships exactly this threshold and population; a test keeps them equal.
